summary.text: Lisa Cutter, a Democrat, represents District 20 (Jefferson County) in the Colorado State Senate, where the General Assembly lists her as Assistant Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: She has held the Senate seat since January 2023, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 25) from 2019 to 2023.
She earned a B.S. in marketing from Metropolitan State College of Denver in 1992.
Her career experience includes founding Cutter Communications and working as a public relations consultant, and she chaired the board of directors of the Women's Bean Project.
